verdict.rationale: The pricing page is referenced (grafana-docs-13) noting a free tier for personal projects, and a community post confirms Grafana Cloud is seen as cheaper than competitors (grafana-comm-9), suggesting some public pricing exists, but the evidence pack contains no actual per-signal (per-metric, per-log-GB, per-trace) rate sheet or cost calculator that would let an SRE predict costs without contacting sales. Missing for 10: published per-signal unit prices, a cost calculator or usage-based rate table, and confirmation that enterprise/high-volume tiers don't require sales engagement.
